# 4M Luxury Boats

> Exclusive private boat tours and self-drive boat rental on Lake Como, Italy. Skippered experiences: sunset aperitivo, breakfast on board, Villa Oleandra (George Clooney), Varenna and Isola Comacina. Departures from Lungo Lario Trieste, Como. Book directly via WhatsApp or email — no middlemen.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://4mboatlakecomo.com): overview, fleet, experiences, location
- [Book a tour](https://4mboatlakecomo.com/booking): packages, prices (from €250), booking form, FAQ
- [Our Story](https://4mboatlakecomo.com/story): about 4M Luxury Boats

## Experiences (per private boat)
- Golden Hour — sunset tour with Prosecco, 1h, from €250
- Breakfast on Board — morning cruise 8:30–10:30, 1h, €300
- Aperitivo Tour — Italian aperitivo at sunset, 1h30, €350
- Como Luxury — Villa Pliniana, Villa Oleandra, Nesso, 2h, €450
- La Dolce Vita — Isola Comacina and Varenna, 4h, €800
